17. Iacob therefore toſe vp, and ſetting his children and wiues vuqu
camels , went his waye 18. And he tooke al his ſubſtance, and flocks,
and whatſoeuer he had gotten in Meſopotamia, and went forward to
Iſaac his father into the land of Chahaan. 10. At that time Laban was
gone to ſheare his ſheep, and Rachel ſtole the idols of her father. 20.
And Iacob would not confeſſe to his father in law that he fled. 21. And
when he was gone as wel himſtlfe as al things that were his right, &
hauing paſſed the riuer was marching on to Mount Galaad, 22. it was
told Laban the third day that Iacob fled. 22. Who, taking his bre-
thren vnto him, purſued him ſeauen dayes: and he ouertook him in
the Mount Galaad. 24. And he ſaw in his fleep God ſaying vnto him:
Take heed thou ſpeake not roughly anie thing againſt Iacob. And
Iacob had now pitched his tent in the mountaine: and when he with
his brethren had ouertaken him, he pitched his tent in the ſame Mount
Galaad. 26. And he ſaid to Iacob: Why dideſt thou ſo, that vnwitting to
me thou wouldeſt carie away my daughters as captiues with the ſword?
27. Wfy wotildeſt thou fly without my khowledge, and not tel mne,
that I might haue brougbt thee on the way with ioy, and ſongs , and
timbrels, and cithetnes? 28. Thou haſt not ſuffred me to kiſſe my
ſonnes and daughters : thou haſt done fooliſhly : now alſo indeed 29.
my hand is able to requite thee euil: but the God ot vour father ſaid
vnto me yeſterday : Take heed thor: ſpeake not any thing againſt
Iacob roughly. 20. Suppoſe thou diddcit defire to goe to thy freinds,
and hadeſt a longing to thy fathers houſe, why dideſt thou ſteale my
Gods? 71. Iacob anſwered : In that I departed vnwitting to thee, I fea-
red leſt thou wouldeſt take away thy daughters by force. 32. But
whereas thou chargeſt me with thett: with whom ſoeuer thou ſhalt
find thy Gods, let him be flaine betore our brethren: ſearch what-
toeuer of thy things thou ſhalt find with me, and take away. Saying
this, he knew not that Rachel had ſtollen the idols. 33. Laban ther-
tore hauing gone into the tent of Iacob, and of Lia, and of both the
handmaids, tound them not. And when he was entred into Rachels
tent, 24. ihe in haſt hid the idols vnder the camels litter, and ſat ther-
vpon: and when he had ſought al the tent , and found nothing, 35. ſhe
ſaid : Let not my Lord be angrie that I can not riſt vp before thee,
becauſe according to the cuitome of women it is now chanced to
me. So his caretulnes in ſeeking was deluded. 36. And Iacob being
angrie ſaid in chiding manner : For what tault ot myne, aud tot
what offence of my part haſt thou ſo chaffed after me, 27. and ſear-

with thee twentic yeares? thy twes and goats were not barren, the
wethers of thy flock I did uot eate : 29. ncyther that which the
beaſt had caught did I ſhew to thee, I made good al the damage:
